claims.content: To capture and maintain accurate, up-to-date distributor master information for tracking and reporting purposes.

goal.raw_text: To capture and maintain accurate, up-to-date distributor master information for tracking and reporting purposes.

claims.content: VMU User
The VMU User must be logged into the system with appropriate permissions to access distributor master records.
The system must have a Distributor Master module available for capturing and updating distributor details.
The user must have permission to perform New, Edit, or Delete operations on distributor records as per screen-level options.
The VMU User initiates the use case by selecting the option to perform New, Edit, or Delete operations on distributor records from the Distributor Master Information screen.

trigger.raw_text: The VMU User initiates the use case by selecting the option to perform New, Edit, or Delete operations on distributor records from the Distributor Master Information screen.

claims.content: The VMU User selects the option to create a new distributor record, edit an existing one, or delete a record (if no child records exist) from the Distributor Master Information screen.

If creating or editing, the system presents fields for capturing distributor master details including: Distributor Code (3 Digit), Name of the distributor, Type of business, Proprietor Name, Designation, Address (Street/Road, Sub District, County, Sub County and Village or Town), Contact No, Email Id, and Status (active/deactivate).
The system validates that all mandatory fields (marked with *) are filled; if not, it prompts the user to complete them.
The system checks for duplicated ID for distributors; if a duplicate name is captured, it displays a warning message prompting the user to change the name or add a differentiating indicator.
Upon successful validation and uniqueness check, the system saves the distributor master record.
The system allows the user to print the distributor master details.

The system provides a provision on the distributor screen to view the Sales History of a particular distributor, displaying summary details such as Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, Balance Qty, and any other details required by the MSIU office.
The user may select a particular distributor to view its details (e.g., sales) by double-clicking on the grid.

If the user attempts to enter a duplicate distributor name, the system displays a warning message prompting the user to either retain the duplicate name with a differentiating indicator or change the name.
If the user attempts to delete a distributor record that has child records created, the system prevents deletion and does not allow the operation.
If any mandatory field (marked with *) is left blank during record creation or update, the system requires completion before proceeding — implied by ‘All fields with * are mandatory!’ constraint.
The distributor master record is successfully created, updated, or deleted (if no child records exist) in the system.
All mandatory fields (marked with *) for the distributor record are populated and validated.
If a duplicate distributor name was entered, it is either changed or retained with a differentiating indicator as warned by the system.
The distributor’s geographical address details (District, Sub-District, County, Sub-County, Village/Town, road/street) are captured and stored.
The distributor’s status (active/deactivate) is set or updated as specified.
Sales History summary details (Batch No, Date of purchase, Qty Purchase, Qty Sold, Qty Returned, Balance Qty, etc.) are available for viewing per distributor via double-click on grid.
Distributor master details can be printed if user has login permission to do so.

Voucher numbers may be withheld by admin team if needed; voucher validity dates may be amended — though not directly part of distributor maintenance, these are system-wide provisions affecting related data.
